text:
sam: FYI — customer reports that a user with the Viewer role gets a 403 on the Billing page. Repro steps below, reproduced on staging and prod. :eyes:

lina: can you paste steps?

sam: 1) login as org viewer
2) go to /orgs/123/billing
3) UI shows 'You don't have permission' and backend returns 403
4) org admin can see billing fine

sam: request id xyz-9a8b in prod trace, attaching short log snippet.

jorge: did we just roll the RBAC refactor last night? @dev-bot any deploy info?

dev-bot: deploy: canary rollout completed to 12% at 2025-11-18T03:12:00Z, release rbac-refactor-v2.

tia: I shipped the refactor. Billing route now evaluates `billing.access` scoped permission. We added a migration that should copy legacy viewer->billing.access for old orgs. Possible migration gap.

hannah: is billing check in frontend only or server-side?

lina: server returns 403, so backend policy failing.

mike: looking at auth logs: eval for user u-789 -> role 'viewer' -> permission 'org.billing.view' = false. No KMS decrypt errors.

jorge: I vaguely remember splitting viewer into scoped perms for billing/editor earlier in the matrix change. Could be a missed migration.

tia: yes — added `billing.access` and intended to backfill old orgs. Migration should have set `billing_migrated = true` on orgs we touched.

sam: customer org created 2020. Maybe it was skipped.

hannah: @tia can you check org row?

tia: running: `select billing_migrated from orgs where id = 123;` -> NULL. so migration not applied.

lina: remediation options: (A) immediate backfill migration for that org, (B) hotfix to treat NULL as legacy=true in auth check, (C) UI bandaid. Backend fix is priority.

mike: patch proposal: treat billing_migrated IS NULL and created_at < '2021-01-01' as legacy org and grant billing.view to viewer until backfill completes. I can run query to list affected orgs.

tia: I'll open a migration PR and a small auth-fallback patch. Need sec approval for temporary fallback.

hannah: security note: granting access must be audited. We need to emit an audit event for each user who accesses billing due to fallback, and include KMS audit marker for the migration job.

jorge: also wrap the fallback behind a feature flag so we can turn it off quickly if anything odd shows up.

sam: proposed runbook: 1) backfill migration for affected orgs 2) deploy auth-fallback behind FF for 1 hour window while backfill runs 3) emit per-access audit events and a migration audit record 4) notify customer and record incident IN-2026-1024

mike: query results: `select id from orgs where billing_migrated is null and created_at < '2021-01-01';` -> ~42 orgs. I'll push full list to #incidents.

dev-bot: incident created: IN-2026-1024 - viewer-billing-visibility, priority P2, owner tia.

tia: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4821 (migration + small auth fallback). pinging @hannah @jorge for review.

hannah: quick review done. Approve if PR includes: (1) migration writes KMS-audit metadata for the backfill job, (2) per-org audit event, (3) the fallback FF default off, and (4) a limit that the fallback auto-turns off after 2 hours.

jorge: also add a unit test around `getPermissionForOrg()` showing behavior when `billing_migrated` is NULL.

sam: scheduling: want to run backfill in tonight's maintenance window (30m). Any objections?

lina: no objections. I'll update maintenance calendar.

mike: I'll run backfill and monitor errors and quota. Will post results here.

sam: thanks all — I'll draft the customer note and include expected ETA. :thumbsup:

tia: starting backfill in a few. will post progress.

mike: backfill finished for org 123, migration flag set to true, auth-fallback not needed. monitoring billing page loads — first checks look good.

sam: great. closing loop once we see no further customer reports. I'll update incident and send comms.

lina: note for postmortem: verify the migration job logging and add periodic audit to ensure no orgs left with NULL after major role refactors.

hannah: add a small eval to Redwood Optimize to surface regressions when the role matrix changes.

sam: agreed. Thanks team.
